description: This file is a shell script used for testing the 'git rebase --merge' functionality. It sets up a repository, performs various branch operations, and verifies that rebase and merge behaviors are as expected, including handling conflicts, cherry-pick reapplication, and filtering blobs during rebase.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Runs a test case expecting success, taking a description and commands to execute.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail, used for testing error conditions.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches output for a specified pattern, used for assertions.

methods.name: test_config
methods.description: Runs a git config command to set repository configurations for testing.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
